issues.issue: Was the applicant denied procedural fairness because the Officer treated her affidavit as mere allegation and did not put doubts to her in an interview?
issues.applicant_position: Officer should have accepted affidavit facts absent a credibility finding and allowed an interview; procedural fairness breached, correctness applies.
issues.respondent_position: Officer's findings concern sufficiency of evidence, not credibility; reasonableness applies; no breach of natural justice.
issues.result_text: No breach of natural justice; the Officer's findings were about sufficiency of evidence.

issues.issue: Was the Officer's H&C decision unreasonable on establishment, hardship, country conditions and best interests of the children?
issues.applicant_position: Officer relied on speculation, misjudged employment prospects (teacher/cleaner), undervalued financial support and gender violence evidence.
issues.respondent_position: Officer considered all evidence reasonably; burden on applicant to corroborate; teacher/daycare error not determinative.
issues.result_text: Officer duly considered all evidence; outcome defensible; court will not reassess the evidence.
